title: Armistice of Mudros
description: The Ottoman Empire leaves the First World War and opens the Straits to the Allies.

title: Allied occupation of Constantinople
description: Allied forces enter the capital two weeks after the armistice and occupy it formally in March 1920.

title: Greek landing at Smyrna
description: Greek troops land with Allied backing, starting the Greco-Turkish War.

title: Mustafa Kemal lands at Samsun
description: The conventional starting point of the Turkish national movement.

title: Treaty of Sèvres
description: The sultan's government signs a partition of the empire that is never ratified.

title: Battle of the Sakarya
description: The Greek advance on Ankara is stopped.

title: Battle of Dumlupınar
description: The Great Offensive breaks the Greek army in Anatolia.

title: Armistice of Mudanya
description: The Allies concede Eastern Thrace and Constantinople to the Ankara government.

title: Abolition of the sultanate
description: The Grand National Assembly ends the Ottoman monarchy after roughly six centuries.

title: Treaty of Lausanne
description: Replaces Sèvres and sets the borders of the new Turkish state.
